Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood order form — indemnity redlines and evidence ask

Jordan / Ben — thanks for the ping. Quick summary from legal after initial review:

- Defense-control: insensitive for us to give blanket defense-control to customer for all third-party IP claims. That would materially impair our ability to manage settlements and insurance recoveries.

- Proposed compromise: accept customer defense-control only where (a) the claim arises solely from Customer-provided data, instructions, or content (i.e., not Redwood model output or hosted model code), and (b) the claim does not seek indemnity for Redwood's own breach of warranty or willful misconduct. In other words, carve out Redwood-origin claims and operationally high-risk categories.

- Evidence checklist: we can accept a constrained set — (1) exact sample prompt or content that allegedly induces infringement, (2) timestamps + request/response transcript (tokenized), (3) verification of customer's vendor source code or asset chain where third-party code is implicated, (4) claim notice and court/agent contact info. We'll provide a template.

- Notice windows: 30 days is reasonable for initial notice. We push for ability to request up to 14 days of additional time to collect logs/evidence.

Attached: Redlines_summary_for_internal.pdf (internal note with clause language and markup suggestions) and Evidence_requirements_stub.xlsx (sample fields we would accept).

Next steps: Jordan, propose we send Novacorp a one-page compromise with the carveout language and the evidence checklist. Ben, confirm ops can deliver request/response transcripts and retention policy; if we need an ops runbook, flag now. If Novacorp insists on blanket defense-control we'll need to mark as a pricing/insurance exception and escalate to finance/exec.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference

Team — quick status and ask for approval to proceed with the compromise below to Novacorp:

Proposed one-page compromise (to send to Novacorp):
- Redwood will accept customer defense-control limited to claims that arise solely from Customer-provided content/instructions or third-party vendor assets provided by the Customer.
- Exclusions: Redwood-origin output, claims arising from Redwood updates/patches, and claims alleging breach of Redwood warranty or willful misconduct.
- Evidence: customer must provide (a) the exact request/prompt, (b) a sanitized request/response transcript (we will redact PII), (c) vendor asset provenance docs, and (d) official claim notice. Redwood may request up to 14 additional days to collect internal logs; remedies timeline will be tolled during any such extension.

- Kimberly: confirm final legal language and sign-off to send to Erin (target: EOD Wednesday).
- Ben: confirm ops can deliver sanitized transcripts and list retention policy (target: EOD Tuesday). Please include estimated effort if a custom data pull is required.
- Jordan: I'll send the one-page compromise to Erin and procurement once you confirm legal language.

If legal signs off we will not treat this as an insurance exception; if Novacorp insists on broader defense-control we'll escalate with suggested pricing/limit options.

Thanks,
